column1: # Size and shape limits broken in src/ that stay for now, one per line: the file, the rule, the nearest named
# function around the breach ((file) for a file too long, (top) outside any function, name #2 for a repeat), the
# cap, then the reason, tab separated. The cap is what the breach measured when it was listed: lines, complexity,
# parameters, or for nesting the depth of the function's deepest block, one line per function; 1 for each nested
# ternary or shadowed name. npm run limits fails on a breach missing here, on one above its cap and on a line whose
# breach is gone; a breach at or below its cap passes.
